title: Grafana datasource discovery and summary
prompt: Use the connected MCP server to inspect the available execution workflow, then run code through its execute tool to find and call the Grafana datasource-listing operation. Return a concise summary of the datasource count and include the operation/tool path you used. Do not invent data if Grafana returns an error; report the error details instead.
expectations: Calls the target MCP execute tool instead of answering from memory.
Uses search/describe or equivalent workflow before calling Grafana.
Mentions the selected Grafana datasource operation path or tool path.
Does not dump a full raw execution envelope.
